artworks.title: Four Statues
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image displays four sculptures on a wooden platform. The first sculpture on the left shows a male figure seated, raising his left arm and holding an object resembling a horn or shell. He wears minimal clothing. The second sculpture depicts a male figure seated with his back slightly turned. The third sculpture features a kneeling figure with a basket or cornucopia on its head filled with fruits and vegetables. The fourth sculpture shows a kneeling figure with a flat, round object on its head. All sculptures are monochrome and appear to be made of light-colored stone or plaster.

artworks.title: The Crawlers
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts an older woman seated on the ground against a brick wall. She is looking down with her eyes closed, wearing a headscarf and holding something in her arms. She is dressed in a long skirt and a blouse with long sleeves. Nearby are a teacup and a small pot on the ground, highlighting a simple setting. In the background, there are dark bricks and a doorway or frame of a building.

artworks.title: Portrait of Two Boys
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image features two young boys in a half-length portrait. The boy on the left stands with one elbow resting on the shoulder of the seated boy, who is positioned to the right. Both boys have short dark hair, parted neatly to one side. Their facial expressions are neutral, and they have fair skin. They are dressed in formal dark suits with white shirts and high collars. There is no visible jewelry or objects in their hands. The background is a plain gradient of earthy tones, transitioning from green to brown, and the boys are seated against a wooden surface or furniture.

artworks.title: Mississippi Cotton Gin at Dahomey
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This photograph shows the interior of a large industrial building filled with piles of raw cotton and large machinery. Wooden support beams stretch up to a tall, planked ceiling, all covered in fluffy white cotton. There are several large machines with cotton accumulating around them, including one close to us at the bottom left. A burlap sack is clamped into a mechanical press in the large machine, appearing full of white cotton. Around and on top of this machine are five men, all working on different areas. One turns a wheel, one holds a hammer, two push a large wooden beam, and one stands behind a long plank. All of these men have dark brown skin and wear shirts and trousers with suspenders. They are all covered in white cotton. In the background are more men, standing in different areas of the building and looking towards the machine in the bottom left. These men wear jackets and wide-brimmed hats. Two appear to have dark skin, and two appear to have light skin, although the photograph is faded and details are indistinct.

artworks.title: A Monday Washing, New York City
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This photograph shows an elevated view of a densely packed urban area. The horizon is near the top of the frame, with distant city skyscrapers in the background behind a light blue sky. Closest to us, laundry lines crisscross between tenement buildings, carrying colorful clothes and linens in shades of white, light blue, light pink, and yellow. The clothes overlap, crossing through the center of the image. The tan and brown buildings form a corridor leading to the far row of buildings, with the open sky above them.  The colors range from pastel and muted tones to earthy colors.

artworks.title: Elephantiasis
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright, facing slightly to the side to reveal their right profile. They have short dark hair under a wide-brimmed hat and Asian facial features. The monochrome photo is damaged, making details hard to discern. The person wears minimal clothing, possibly shorts or a loincloth, with their legs covered, possibly with fabric or bandaging. The background is textured with a blue overlay, typical of an aged print. Handwritten notes mention the location as Yokohama, Japan, and reference anthropological context and "elephantiasis."

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image depicts a painting of a man's upper body, centered in an oval frame. He is angled slightly to the left, facing the viewer with a composed expression. The man has distinct facial features, a well-defined jawline, short wavy hair parted on the side, sideburns, and a neat moustache. He wears a dark suit, high-collared white shirt, and dark bow tie. The background is a muted blue. The oval painting is within a wide, dark wooden frame with carved detailing on the edge.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man from the shoulders up. He is facing slightly to his left, with his head turned towards the viewer and a direct gaze. He has light-colored skin, short, dark hair, and prominent sideburns. The man is dressed in formal attire, wearing a black jacket, white shirt, and black bow tie. The background is plain and muted, with an ornate, gold-colored frame surrounding the portrait. No visible jewelry or objects are in the portrait.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows the upper part of a man's body, focusing on his torso and head. He is facing forward, looking directly at the camera. The man has neatly styled dark hair, mutton-chop sideburns, a high forehead, straight nose, and a slightly open expression. He wears a dark coat and a high-collared white shirt with a dark cravat. The portrait is in an ornate frame with a gold-colored mat and a purple velvet-like lining. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man seated with his body slightly turned to the left. His features include a high forehead and a beard on his chin and jawline. His hair is dark and combed back away from his face. He is dressed in formal attire, featuring a dark suit with a waistcoat, a white shirt, and a bow tie. His posture is relaxed, with one arm resting on a patterned cushion or armrest. The photograph has an ornate oval frame with a gold and red border. The background is plain and neutral.

artworks.title: Orange Packing at Redlands
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an orange packing plant. The image shows an interior of an industrial space filled with wooden crates and boxes of oranges, some of which are open to reveal the fruit inside. The setting includes beams supporting the roof overhead, strings hanging from the ceiling, and various tools or equipment scattered throughout the space. Several crates have logos or labels on them, and there is a large platform on which oranges are being processed. The overall color tone is sepia with hints of colorization.

artworks.title: Ute Chief Severo and Family
artworks.artist: Charles A. Nast, Detroit Photographic Company
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a group of eight individuals, with most of their bodies visible. In the center, a man is standing while the others are seated around him. The man has short hair, dark facial features, and wears a dark-colored hat, a blue jacket with a white scarf, and a dark-colored shirt underneath. Surrounding him are six adults and two infants. The adults have long, dark hair and wear various traditional clothing with intricate patterns and vibrant colors, including blankets and robes. Some of the individuals wear large hoop earrings and have adornments on their garments. Two infants are in cradleboards on either side of the group, wrapped in blankets, their faces visible. The background is plain, with muted tones and a slightly textured appearance, focusing attention on the people in the image.

artworks.title: In the Petrified Forest (General View, Middle Park)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a wide, arid landscape seen from an elevated perspective. The horizon is high, emphasizing the expansive scene. Large rock formations, possibly petrified wood, are scattered on the earth's surface. In the distance, there are hills and more rocks. The color scheme is sepia, giving an aged feel to the scenery. The image captures the isolation and ruggedness of the environment.

artworks.title: Downeville Butte
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The landscape image shows a distant mountain range dominating the horizon line, situated below the midpoint of the image. In the foreground, a dense forest of dark trees covers rolling terrain, contrasting with the lighter mountains beyond. The detail in the trees enhances the textural contrast with the mountains. The color palette consists of muted earthy browns and grays, giving the image a timeless feel. The sky is a soft, washed-out tone, serving as a tranquil background for the mountains.

artworks.title: Donner Lake, California
artworks.dimensions:
image: 12.7 x 12.7 cm (5 x 5 in.)
sheet: 17.8 x 17.8 cm (7 x 7 in.)
mount: 23.2 x 23.2 cm (9 1/8 x 9 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image captures a landscape with rocky terrain stretching into the distance. The horizon shows mountains and a body of water. The foreground is dominated by large boulders with a textured surface, leading towards the distant lake. The color palette is monochromatic with browns and grays. The composition directs the viewer's focus from the rocky structures to the water and sky.

artworks.title: Alcatraz Island and San Francisco Bay, Looking North
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene from an elevated viewpoint, looking downhill towards a body of water and a distant landmass. The horizon divides the townscape below from the water and land further away. Sailing ships are seen anchored on the water, and elegant buildings line the street. A horse-drawn cart indicates activity in the area. The town extends towards the shore where the land meets the water. The color palette is sepia, creating a vintage atmosphere with warm tones highlighting architectural details and the calmness of the scene.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: salted paper print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image depicts an older man in a formal portrait. He is seated upright, facing the viewer. The man has short, grayish-white hair and light blue eyes. He wears a black suit, a white shirt, and a white cravat. He holds a cane in his right hand. The background is plain and dark, with a gold frame surrounding the portrait.

artworks.title: Photographie Lunaire Capuanus - Bouillaud - Gassendi
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed view of a lunar surface, showcasing various craters and textures. The perspective is an aerial view directly over the moon's surface with no visible horizon. The surface displays crater formations with different sizes, some with raised rims and shadows. The color palette consists of grayscale tones, ranging from dark to light areas. The texture is realistic, resembling a photographic capture. In the distance, the surface appears smoother and less cratered.

artworks.title: Photographie Lunaire Albategnius - Triesnecker - Manilius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a top-down view of the moon's surface, densely populated with craters of varying sizes. The view lacks a visible horizon as it is focused on the lunar terrain. The craters cover the entire visual field, creating a pattern of circular depressions and ridges. The image is photographic, with clear, defined edges and shadows within the craters. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting mainly of grays and whites. Light and shadow play across the craters, indicating the angle of illumination.
